json.explanation: The main panel is the gray exterior enclosure beside the meter. It looks modern and clean, with no visible rust or corrosion on the enclosure, and the cover is closed in photo 1 and photo 14. The photos are low-resolution security-camera stills taken from a distance. The manufacturer label cannot be read, even with the door open (photos 2, 3 and 13), and breaker ON/OFF markings and handle orientation are not legible. Photos 7-9 show the dead-front removed with wiring exposed, but that appears to be mid-installation work. With the brand unreadable and breaker orientation unconfirmed, the evidence is not enough to pass.
